title: Harmless Statement Differences (Non-Contradictions)
description: Ensures that omitting minor details, making jokes, or posing hypotheticals are NOT flagged as contradictions.

initial_claim.value: doctoral researcher specializing in Cynthia dynasty artifacts

expected.note: A general statement is consistent with a specific earlier claim.

cases.player_statement: If I were a master thief, I would at least wear a tuxedo like in the spy films!

expected.note: Jokes and sarcasm must not be parsed into biographical identity slots.

cases.player_statement: Hypothetically, if the alarm system were tested tonight, which exit would visitors use?

expected.note: Hypothetical queries are not factual claims about player identity.
